articles.title: A Wobbly Space Peanut with a Watery Secret!
articles.summary: Imagine a giant space peanut tumbling through the asteroid belt! NASA's Lucy spacecraft just flew by asteroid Donaldjohanson and found it wobbles like a top and may have once had water. This peanut-shaped rock is full of surprises.

articles.title: Fake Pills, Real Brain Boost!
articles.summary: What if a sugar pill could make your memory sharper — even when you know it's fake? A new study found older adults who took placebo pills for three weeks got better at remembering things and felt less stressed. The mind is more powerful than we think!

articles.title: A 70-Year Dig Unlocks an Ancient City's Secrets!
articles.summary: For 70 years, archaeologists have been digging at Sardis in Turkey, uncovering a city ruled by Greeks, Romans, and more. Now it's a UNESCO World Heritage site! From the invention of coins to a giant ancient synagogue, this place is a time machine.
